_doc: Per-page hero overrides, keyed by the page path without slashes (e.g. translation-services).
lead: the hero sentence under the H1 (otherwise the meta description is used).
art: names an illustration component (services = components/ServicesHeroArt.jsx).
Keep each lead to the same number of lines as before and each illustration under the hero's content height, so heroes stay one size across pages.

translation-services.lead: Our native specialists carry your message into every market, so it lands exactly as you meant it. Free quote, reply within a couple of hours.
